statusText: Mapped policy state: WATCH. Oil and Treasury yields keep macro stress extreme, while fresh exact NQ evidence of persistent mean-reversion failure is unavailable.
recommendation: Mapped policy state: WATCH. Tail remains below the blocking threshold because current one-way NQ extension and failed-retracement structure are not independently verified.
headline: Oil and yields keep Stress extreme; Tail remains WATCH into Oracle
body: The Nasdaq Composite ended 0.64% lower, Brent settled at $107.63 after a 6.34% jump, and Treasury yields reached multi-year highs after firm August producer prices. These are powerful stress amplifiers, but exact fresh NQ path detail is insufficient to establish a persistent no-retracement regime. Oracle's after-close call is the nearest event checkpoint.

lookbackSummary: Over the preceding 24 clock-hours, Tail moved from WATCH/low overnight to elevated after PPI, peaked at 34, then returned to WATCH as the broader equity decline remained moderate. Stress stayed at or near extreme throughout.
outlookSummary: Oracle's 21:00 UTC call is the immediate checkpoint. Overnight Tail can ease if price discovery remains two-way; Friday CPI at 12:30 UTC is the next major macro window, with any later Tail escalation conditional on observed directional persistence and failed retracements.

forecast.analysis: Nasdaq closed 0.64% lower as Brent settled at $107.63 and yields stayed elevated. Exact fresh NQ retracement detail is unavailable, so Tail remains WATCH.

forecast.analysis: Oracle's 21:00 UTC call is the immediate checkpoint. Two-way after-hours price discovery preserves WATCH; sustained extension with failed pullbacks would raise Tail.
After the Oracle call, materially retracing price discovery would preserve WATCH. Persistent directional efficiency would be the condition for Tail escalation.
As the earnings impulse ages, two-way futures structure would let Tail ease slightly even while oil and yields keep Stress extreme.
At the Asia handoff, range rotation and meaningful retracements would support lower Tail. A clean breakout with shallow pullbacks would negate that easing.
Early Asia is conditionally lower-risk if volatility compresses and extremes are not held. Repeated extension after failed pullbacks would reverse that view.
Without a scheduled U.S. catalyst, rotational overnight trade would keep Tail near WATCH lows. Directional NQ efficiency aligned with rates or oil would raise it.
Thin overnight liquidity keeps path quality central. Continued retracement supports WATCH; a persistent move toward an overnight extreme would be adverse.
Late-Asia extensions that are absorbed would keep Tail contained. Repeated failure to mean-revert would justify a higher assessment.
Ahead of Europe, a balanced NQ range would preserve WATCH. Fresh geopolitical or rates pressure matters most if it aligns with one-way index movement.
The Europe handoff can increase participation. Retracements through the transition preserve WATCH; sustained continuation would be a stronger warning.
Early European trade remains conditional on overnight structure. A balanced range contains Tail; aligned yields, oil and NQ continuation would lift it.
As European liquidity deepens, CPI proximity matters. Tail stays WATCH unless pre-release positioning becomes unusually one-way with shallow retracements.
The U.S. morning transition raises event sensitivity, but event importance alone does not lift Tail. Pre-release directional efficiency is the relevant path signal.
With CPI two hours away, Stress remains extreme. A broad two-way range contains Tail; persistent extension into the release would raise path risk.
One hour before CPI, Tail sits at the top of WATCH. The scheduled release itself is not proof of mean-reversion failure; trend efficiency would be the warning.
August CPI is scheduled at 12:30 UTC. Tail remains WATCH absent observed persistence; failed post-release retracements would be the escalation condition.
The first full post-CPI hour overlaps the cash open. Retracing or rotating price action preserves WATCH; shallow-pullback opening continuation would be adverse.
Michigan sentiment is scheduled at 14:00 UTC. Tail depends on whether the earlier CPI impulse keeps extending or begins to mean-revert.
If CPI and sentiment impulses become two-way by mid-session, Tail can ease. Continued extreme holding with aligned rates would prevent that easing.
Deeper mid-afternoon pullbacks would support lower Tail despite high Stress. Renewed extension after failed retracements would invalidate the easing path.
Late-session Tail can ease if volatility decays and directional efficiency remains low. A shallow-pullback second leg would be the contrary condition.
A rotational later session keeps Tail near WATCH lows. Geopolitical or rates pressure matters most if it aligns with persistent index continuation.
Near the cash close, stable two-way structure keeps Tail at the WATCH floor. A one-way closing auction or repeated extension would require reassessment.

Two-way post-event futures structure would allow modest Tail easing while macro Stress stays extreme.
